meta.title: Packages
meta.subtitle: open source PHP packages on Packagist. SDK builders, HTTP clients, authentication strategies, and API tooling.

packages.name: juststeveking/php-sdk
packages.description: A code-first approach to building SDKs in PHP with a focus on developer experience. Provides a clean, fluent interface for constructing API clients.

packages.name: juststeveking/http-slim
packages.description: A slim PSR-compliant HTTP client to provide better interoperability across PHP projects and frameworks.

packages.name: juststeveking/http-auth-strategies
packages.description: A simple PHP package for creating different HTTP authentication headers. Supports Bearer, Basic, Digest, and custom strategies.

packages.name: juststeveking/http-helpers
packages.description: A collection of helpers to use when working with HTTP in PHP. Status codes, header builders, and response utilities.

packages.name: juststeveking/cloudevents
packages.description: Cloud Events in PHP. A spec-compliant implementation of the CloudEvents standard for event-driven architectures.

packages.name: juststeveking/fluent-validation
packages.description: A helper package that enables sensible defaults for Laravel validation rules with a fluent, readable interface.

packages.name: juststeveking/feed-parser
packages.description: A simple feed parser for PHP with zero dependencies. Parses RSS and Atom feeds cleanly.

packages.name: juststeveking/eloquent-log-driver
packages.description: A Laravel log driver for Eloquent. Persist application logs directly to your database using Laravel's logging pipeline.

packages.name: juststeveking/companies-house-laravel
packages.description: A Laravel wrapper to query Companies House information and validate company numbers against the UK register.

packages.name: juststeveking/config
packages.description: A simple dot notation configuration package for PHP. Access nested config values cleanly without array syntax.

packages.name: juststeveking/gtin-php
packages.description: A PHP package for validating GTIN codes (Global Trade Item Numbers), including EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC-A, and GTIN-14.
